verdict.rationale: Figma's pricing page snippets mention plan-gated features like 'Advanced Dev Mode inspection and MCP Server', 'Centralized admin tools', and AI credit purchasing/allocation controls, implying some tier and AI-feature gating exists, but the evidence pack contains no explicit breakdown of seat types (viewer/editor/dev), tier names, or a full feature-comparison table needed for procurement clarity. Missing for 10: explicit seat-type definitions, named plan tiers with feature matrices, and clear AI-feature gating documentation across all tiers.
